integrity_notes: Analytical proof given for all integer dimensions at least two, all positive time normalizations and interior fidelity targets; finite numerical checks supplement rather than replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical isotropic Brownian fidelity diffusion from zero, at fixed finite dimension and threshold strictly below one.
The full high-fidelity hitting-time law, rather than its first two moments, is not established.
Classical Jacobi first-passage moment formulas predate the present global threshold-ordering inequality.
The 3 November 2026 revised full preprint was inaccessible; only its abstract was available.
title: A sharp harmonic limit for first-passage fluctuations of projective Brownian fidelity
